screen.yujiancraft.guide.contents_hint: Select a chapter to jump directly to it
guide.yujiancraft.page.0.title: Introduction · The Yujian Path
guide.yujiancraft.page.0.body: With this guide in hand, fellow cultivator, you have taken your first step onto the Yujian path. Mine Spirit Ore, forge flying swords, command six implements and learn their arts. The six may pierce from formation, sweep nearby foes, call down the Grand Void Sword Array, guard their master, wield tools or fish through spiritual command. Ordinary weapons, shields, tools and implements from other realms may also be refined into Myriad flying swords and awaken an Artifact Spirit. New disciples should begin with Quick Controls, Spirit Ore & Forging, and Formations & Targeting.
guide.yujiancraft.page.1.title: Contents
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.title: Quick Controls
guide.yujiancraft.page.2.body: Every binding can be changed under Options → Controls → Key Binds → Yujian Craft. %s deploys or recalls the six implements; %s cycles the three formations; %s opens the direct quick switch for formations, arts and combo sets; %s opens Yujian settings, where targeting, glow, effects and more can be adjusted; %s cycles arts; %s casts the Grand Void Sword Array; %s changes the array seal; %s enters or leaves Combo Stance; %s dispatches Toolcraft or Spirit Fishing; and %s toggles targeting and damage against the creature under the crosshair. Avoidance applies to ordinary sorties, combo sweeps and Sword Array area damage. Tamed pets, mounts and Touhou maids are protected automatically. Your manually protected targets can be reviewed under Spirit Avoidance in Yujian Settings.
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.title: Drawing, Guiding & Riding Swords
guide.yujiancraft.page.3.body: In Crosshair Lock, hold a flying sword and press %s to choose a creature; the same input still swings or mines normally. In Spirit-Sense Guidance, first press %s to release every ready sword, guide them with your gaze, then aim at a target and press %s to commit. Repeated %s inputs in Combo Stance prepare the next form before the current one fully settles. With a usable flying sword in your inventory, double-tap %s to take off or land; press %s to rise and %s to descend while movement keys choose your course.
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.title: Spirit Ore & Forging
guide.yujiancraft.page.4.body: Spirit Ore lies beneath the Overworld, taking a deepslate form in the lowest strata. Mine it with iron tier or better; Fortune yields more crystals while Silk Touch preserves the ore. To forge a base flying sword, place its vanilla sword in the centre, matching material on the four cardinal slots and Spirit Crystals in the corners. Surround the result with eight more crystals to create a Spiritforged sword. Crystals also craft the workstations and this guide. A sword's description shows its attributes, damage per pierce and temper count.
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.title: Formations & Targeting
guide.yujiancraft.page.5.body: Aligned Fan, Rear Ring and Side-blade Fan change where the six implements rest and how they leave formation, but never restrict the chosen art. Crosshair Lock keeps one target until it falls or another is chosen. Auto Targeting lets each sword seek a nearby enemy. Spirit-Sense Guidance follows your gaze. Single Sortie strikes once and returns; Relentless Piercing passes through, bends back and attacks again. A sword must settle briefly in formation before its next sortie.
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.title: Implement Natures & Arts
guide.yujiancraft.page.6.body: Every implement has an art that best suits its nature. Blades favour Piercing, heavy implements Sweep, ranged weapons the Grand Void Sword Array, shields Myriad Guard, tools Toolcraft and rods Spirit Fishing. Unclassified implements begin with Piercing. Choose an art in Yujian settings or cycle the arts permitted in the current world. The Sword Array needs no lasting lock: simply aim at a target in range and cast. Its celestial seal also has switchable Gilded and Tricolour forms.
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.title: Yujian Combo Stance
guide.yujiancraft.page.7.body: Deploy all six implements to enter Combo Stance and direct mid-range sword forms by hand. Sword intent favours enemies near the reticle without harshly seizing your view; only a distant target draws a gentle correction. Flowing Balance is steady and restrained. Fourfold Balance adds two crossing diagonal cuts. Mountain Stride uses broad, forceful changes of position. Sword-Shadow Shifting moves body and sword through a chain of spatial steps. Repeated clicks prepare later forms; waiting too long, losing the target or leaving the stance returns the sequence to its opening form.
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.title: Sword Riding & Camera
guide.yujiancraft.page.8.body: Sword Riding requires only one usable flying sword somewhere in your inventory. A separate support sword manifests beneath you, leaving all six combat implements free. Control direction and altitude in flight; ending the art never removes any flight ability you already possessed. Optimized third person places the character slightly off-centre while keeping locks, mining and interaction aligned with the reticle, and draws the camera closer in confined spaces. Crosshair, outlines, camera and sword brightness may all be adjusted to taste.
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.title: Workbench & Cores
guide.yujiancraft.page.9.body: The Flying Sword Workbench installs or removes Flame, Lightning, Blight, Burst, Arrow Rain, Edge, Endurance, Indestructible and Molten cores. Material counts of 1, 16 and 64 usually correspond to levels I, II and III, and the workbench shows the sword's resulting appearance. Most cores can be removed and return their materials. Re-tempering the same implement, however, disperses all installed Yujian cores; ordinary and third-party enchantments, names and durability remain intact.
guide.yujiancraft.page.10.title: Myriad Swords & Tempering
guide.yujiancraft.page.10.body: A Myriad flying sword is not one fixed weapon, but any worthy implement refined into the Yujian path. Place a weapon, shield, tool or fishing implement in the upper Tempering Table slot and offer one native flying sword as its spiritual core below. The ritual preserves the original name, enchantments, durability, appearance and ordinary use while granting formations, flight, arts and removable cores. Spirit tempering reforges the vessel and gathers an Artifact Spirit, whose name appears in the item's description. Each implement may be tempered at most twice.
guide.yujiancraft.page.11.title: Nature, Shaping & Cost
guide.yujiancraft.page.11.body: First define the implement's nature, then shape how it manifests in formation. The suggested nature is only guidance and may be changed to suit your own interpretation. Shaping adjusts direction, flip, scale, body glow, aura width and aura length. Complex forms may keep only the outer aura or preserve their original appearance. Confirm the shape before entering the Spirit Trial. Entry immediately consumes the required levels and the lower core sword; any Yujian cores already installed on the implement also disperse, so inspect both items first.
guide.yujiancraft.page.12.title: Spirit Trial
guide.yujiancraft.page.12.body: Inside the Spirit Trial stands a gold-and-jade Trialblade Pedestal. Strike the downward-pointing golden sword suspended at its heart with the implement being refined; the first valid hit begins ten seconds of testing. Damage from the implement itself, a projectile it launched, or one authorised trial sword is recognised; other inventory weapons, multiple swords and lingering core damage cannot enter the result. Potions, accessories and temporary blessings remain valid preparations. The power shown across those ten seconds becomes intrinsic piercing damage, the Artifact Spirit takes form, and you return to your former world.
guide.yujiancraft.page.13.title: Damage, Durability & Replenishing
guide.yujiancraft.page.13.body: Intrinsic piercing sets the base power of a flying sword both in hand and in flight. Sharpness, Smite and other enchantments, together with potions, accessories, attributes and the Edge core, still add to actual damage. Lightning, Burst and similar secondary powers are never forged back into the intrinsic value. Flying swords accept matching repair materials in an anvil, while Myriad Guard spends durability faster when intercepting blows. One Spirit Crystal at the Replenishing Table restores one quarter of the combined physical and Endurance-core reserve.
guide.yujiancraft.page.14.title: Six Arts in Detail
guide.yujiancraft.page.14.body: Piercing supports Single Sortie, Relentless Piercing and direct Spirit-Sense Guidance. Sweep sends all six implements through rapid close-range circuits. The Grand Void Sword Array requires every sword ready: it suppresses the target, unfolds a celestial seal, rains sword-qi and ends with a giant sword. Myriad Guard meets attacks from their incoming direction, reflects harm and carries installed core powers. Toolcraft dispatches one ready tool at a time under ordinary mining rules. Spirit Fishing can command several rods, inherits Luck, Luck of the Sea and Lure, and returns every catch to your inventory.
guide.yujiancraft.page.15.title: Settings, Companions & Troubleshooting
guide.yujiancraft.page.15.body: Adjust camera, crosshair, sound, sword brightness and visual effects in Yujian settings. Disable bright flashes immediately if they cause discomfort. Everyone travelling together should use the same mod version; damage, range, cooldowns and art strength follow the rules of the current world. If a crash or strange conflict appears, first try with only Forge and Yujian Craft, then share latest.log or the crash report with the Minecraft, Forge, Java, mod and shader versions involved. Remove tokens, server addresses and personal file paths before sharing any log.
